description.zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示。
description.en: The page number from which to start displaying the returned results. Default value: 1, which indicates that the display starts from page 1.

description.zh: 要查询的防勒索策略防护的服务器的识别信息。可输入服务器的IP地址或实例ID。
description.en: The identification information of the server protected by the anti-ransomware policy to query. You can enter the IP address or instance ID of the server.

description.zh: 要查询的防勒索防护策略的名称。
description.en: The name of the anti-ransomware protection policy to query.

description.zh: 设置分页查询时，每页包含的备份策略的数量。默认值为10，表示每页包含10个防护策略。
description.en: The number of backup policies on each page during paginated queries. Default value: 10, which indicates that each page contains 10 protection policies.

description.zh:
防勒索防护策略的状态。

- **enabled**：策略已手动启用。

- **disabled**：策略已手动停用。策略停用后，正在运行的备份任务将停止。

- **closed**：防勒索容量超出，系统停用策略。
description.en:
The status of the anti-ransomware protection policy.

- **enabled**: The policy is manually enabled.

- **disabled**: The policy is manually disabled. After the policy is disabled, running backup tasks will stop.

- **closed**: The anti-ransomware capacity is exceeded, and the system disables the policy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-backup-policies --name SecurityStrategy-20200303 --machine-remark 1.1.XX.XX --status enabled --page-size 10 --current-page 1 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
